ops.text: Merging a SKILL.md/reference PR needs CI green on the head and a rebase right before merging, but main lands a skill-text PR every few minutes and the lr-go check alone takes about five minutes, so PR 2131 went through six rebase-and-CI cycles (four with conflicts on lines other PRs had just reworded) before a window opened. A helper that rebases, re-applies the rename rules, and merges the moment the pushed head is green, or a rule that a clean trial merge with no upstream test changes may merge server-side, would remove the chase.
